A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CARINOX work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete Appendices A–M support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original CARINOX benchmark experiments, a 200-prompt human evaluation, reward-correlation analyses, and appendix ablations and GenEval results.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark experiments, human evaluation, correlation analyses, and empirical appendix results.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same four-reward objective, per-reward gradient clipping, norm regularization, and optimization followed by best-of-N selection. Newly specified hyperparameter values document the existing procedure.

E1.justification: T2I-CompBench++, HRS, MS-COCO, GenEval, and the human-evaluation coverage are retained. The new reward-landscape schematic is not an additional test scenario.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged in the corresponding human, benchmark, reward, and appendix comparisons. The BLIP-to-BLIP-2 wording correction matches the model already identified in v3's correlation tables.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the evaluation metrics, backbones, 200-prompt human study, default five-seed/50-iteration configuration, and NFE-matched settings. The learning rate and regularization coefficient are newly disclosed, with no evidence of a changed experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The iteration/seed, individual-reward, adaptive-weighting, clipping, and regularization ablations are retained. Section 3 uses the same failure examples; its added landscape is explicitly explanatory rather than a measured analysis.

E5.justification: Human-rating aggregation, Spearman/Kendall correlation reporting, and Table 8's gradient-norm means and standard deviations are unchanged. No repeated-run counts or uncertainty-reporting procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 12 corrects CARINOX means at N=2, T=25: SD-Turbo 0.5531 to 0.5514, SDXL-Turbo 0.5531 to 0.5532, and PixArt-αDMD 0.5522 to 0.5531, with unchanged category scores. The introduction revises the largest T2I-CompBench++ gains to color, shape, and texture; Section 5.4 replaces creativity with style among SD-Turbo's largest HRS gains. Section 3 also changes the knife example from a texture failure to object omission.

T1.justification: Equations 1–15 retain the same mathematical definitions, objectives, and derivations. The new schematic introduces no formal assumption, proposition, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract changes the claimed average improvements from 16% on T2I-CompBench++ and 11% on HRS to approximately 19% on both. The introduction now specifies an approximately 0.19 absolute gain averaged equally across three backbones. The central contribution and scope remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 3 qualifies the interpretation of retained failures. v3 invokes stagnation/divergence and sparse well-aligned solutions; v4 separates an illustrative landscape from observed examples and explicitly makes exploration success depend on both candidate coverage and reward discrimination. Appendix limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.1.1 newly specifies learning rate η=1 and regularization strength γ=0.01; v3 names these parameters without their values. The project-link destination, hardware information, and pseudocode are retained.

R1.justification: The cited-work inventory and substantive research positioning are unchanged. Citation-year and model-name corrections align passages with references and terminology already present in v3.

P1.justification: Section 3 is locally rewritten and reordered around the new schematic. The introduction, result summaries, terminology, and cross-references receive limited edits; the overall section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: v4 adds the reward-landscape schematic as Figure 2 and expands the retained failure-panel caption, now Figure 3, to explain existing red boxes. Other figures and tables reflow, while existing generated-image examples and plots are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 improves reproducibility by specifying two previously undocumented hyperparameters and improves numerical consistency by correcting Table 12's means to match its category scores. Revised gain summaries and the more careful Section 3 explanation also improve clarity. These are limited gains within largely unchanged scientific evidence; the abstract's '19%' wording remains imprecise about absolute versus relative improvement.
